summary: Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an SEC-registered offering of $250M in 6.25% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036. The notes pay 6.25% semi-annually until August 1, 2031, then float at SOFR + 213 bps quarterly. Terms include call options on/after August 1, 2031, or upon tax/regulatory events, at par plus accrued interest, subject to Federal Reserve approval. The notes are unsecured, subordinated, not convertible, and not listed. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other special-situation elements; the filing represents ordinary financing activity.
